question: What does the combined fixed-flux, fixed-head, transfer and same-partition evidence imply about minimum useful vertical dimension, state placement and closure burden before computational cost is considered?

representation_frontier.state_information: B01 bounded future-response candidate; no 1x reduction-induced aliases in A1.
representation_frontier.fixed_flux_propagation: Not broadly adequate with tested storage-only/global-moment closures; critical standard-LARE redistribution error remained large.
representation_frontier.fixed_head: Below B01 comparator-relative groundwater frontier; qualitative exchange errors remain.

representation_frontier.state_information: No demonstrated A1 predictive-information gain over L3 in B01 cohort.
representation_frontier.closure_value: Localized fourth storage strongly improves long-to-local closure resolution; global first moment at equal scalar dimension does not.
representation_frontier.fixed_head_B01: First frozen short-horizon comparator-relative groundwater frontier member.
representation_frontier.transfer: Targeted placement stably supported on 5 of 6 materials; B05 is the counterexample.

representation_frontier.state_information: No demonstrated A1 predictive-information gain over L3 in the B01 common cohort.
representation_frontier.fixed_flux: Substantially lower standard-LARE critical redistribution error than L4.
representation_frontier.fixed_head_continuous_time: Large groundwater-fidelity improvement over L4 on difficult B02/B05/B06; B11/B12 exchange already near numerical/reference floor.

representation_frontier.state_information: Not established as necessary state dimension; extra states are primarily closure/localization resolution in current evidence.
representation_frontier.placement_transfer: Targeted lower-zone placement stably supported on all 6 transfer materials.
representation_frontier.fixed_head_continuous_time: Groundwater exchange reaches or approaches equal-grid residual for several materials; B05 and B06 retain material residual.

representation_frontier.role: No-spatial-reduction Layer-ROM operator control, not a ROM.
representation_frontier.finding: After Reference temporal-limit correction, residual is tiny but nonzero on some materials; useful operator/numerical control only.

state_vs_closure_attribution: B01 future-response information saturates by L3 within the tested cohort, while propagated fidelity continues to improve from L3 through higher localized dimensions. This is direct evidence that state-information sufficiency and closure sufficiency are separate axes.

The equal-dimension L3+M1 experiment fails to replace L4. The fourth scalar is useful because it is localized adjacent to the active interface, not simply because scalar dimension increases from three to four.

Same-partition CoRichards shows that some low-dimensional error is ordinary Richards spatial discretization and some is Layer-ROM-specific closure/localization burden. The relative contribution changes by material and dimension.

At L4, CoRichards is componentwise no-worse on B02, B05 and B06, while Layer-ROM is no-worse on B11, B12 and B16. There is therefore no material-independent claim that either reduced closure or coarse Richards is intrinsically superior at equal dimension.
At L6, only B05 retains a CoRichards componentwise advantage. At R8, B05 becomes a tradeoff and Layer-ROM is componentwise no-worse on the other five materials.
A Layer-ROM componentwise advantage over same-partition CoRichards is not interpreted as superior physics because compensating errors are possible.

GW_R.structural_evidence: Targeted L6/R8 strongly reduce storage and cumulative-exchange residuals; R8 is the first tested dimension with six-material placement support and no CoRichards-dominant material under the full groundwater vector.
GW_R.caveat: B05:R8 remains a tradeoff and no external recharge tolerance is bound.

GW_D.structural_evidence: Flux sign, QAVG and QEND strongly constrain low dimension. B05 requires substantially more resolution than B11/B12; dimension cannot be fixed independent of material.

SCI_P.structural_evidence: Mapped profile error remains materially dimension-sensitive after groundwater exchange has reached near-floor levels, especially on B11/B12. Profile/process research therefore has a stricter representation need than exchange-only purposes.

material_dependence.B05: Persistent hard case: CoRichards no-worse at L4/L6 and R8 is a tradeoff; Layer-ROM R8 still has corrected continuous-time cumulative-bottom RMS 0.0331344 cm, QAVG RMS 0.0834734 cm/day and one QEND sign mismatch.
material_dependence.B02: L4 is closure-burden-limited relative to CoRichards; L6/R8 reverse the componentwise relation.
material_dependence.B06: Same pattern as B02: CoRichards no-worse at L4, Layer-ROM no-worse at L6/R8.
material_dependence.B11_B12: Groundwater exchange is at or near temporal-limit residual at moderate dimension while profile reconstruction continues improving; strong purpose-dependence.
material_dependence.B16: Layer-ROM is componentwise no-worse than CoRichards across L4/L6/R8 on the frozen groundwater vector; profile still improves with dimension.

minimum_dimension_statements.forbidden: There is no universal minimum layer count established by current evidence.
minimum_dimension_statements.B01_state_information: L3 is the bounded minimum predictive-state-information candidate in the A1 cohort.
minimum_dimension_statements.B01_short_fixed_head_comparator_frontier: L4 is the bounded first groundwater comparator-relative crossing.
minimum_dimension_statements.six_material_targeted_placement: R8 is the first tested targeted dimension with stable placement support on all six transfer materials.

fidelity_freeze_for_cost_screen.FMC: Include only if exact fixed-head regime and inherited FMC authority match the cost workload; otherwise report separately.
fidelity_freeze_for_cost_screen.fixed_physics: pure hydraulics, no sinks, fixed 160 cm bottom, prescribed zero pressure head, zero top flux
fidelity_freeze_for_cost_screen.rule: Cost may now be screened without changing state, partition, closure, time-integration science or fidelity metrics.

phase_B_adjudication: The central Layer-ROM hypothesis remains viable, but not as a universal 3- or 4-layer replacement.
The evidence favors a small targeted layer ladder whose useful dimension depends on material and purpose.

L4 is an aggressive low-cost candidate, L6 is an intermediate candidate with much smaller difficult-material residual, and R8 is the first tested targeted representation with placement support across the full six-material panel.
The dominant design principle is local resolution where hydraulic gradients control exchange, not uniform layering and not a single global gradient moment.
No empirical correction is justified by current evidence.
Fidelity is now sufficiently frozen to begin a shared-host cost screen of L4/L6/R8 versus same-partition CoRichards and R16; that screen cannot by itself establish a formal or portable speedup.
next_research_question: What computational reduction is actually obtained by L4, L6 and R8 on the frozen six-material fixed-head panel when measured against same-partition CoRichards and R16 without changing the fidelity definitions?
